name: Verify 3D Assessment De-biasing & Scrying Mirror Privacy
description: Kiro agent hook that triggers when the 3D Crisis Simulator or Scrying Mirror computer-vision modules are modified to enforce psychometric de-biasing, hybrid click/tap + keyboard controls, and on-device webcam privacy.

action.prompt: Verify against .kiro/rules.md and .kiro/specs/ghost-career-counselor/requirements.md that: (1) Crisis Simulator 3D hides the 4 core dimension names on the start screen behind mystery cards, rotates both goalpost colors and compass directions across scenarios in assessmentData.js, and supports both mouse click/touch tap raycasting and WASD/Arrow keys, and (2) ScryingMirror.jsx and faceLandmarkerService.js compute eyebrow, mouth, and stress telemetry 100% locally in-browser and wire cleanly into Auto-Comfort mode.
